title: Pomegranate Smoothie
description: Simple, fast, nutrient dense, and an amazing shade of pink, this pomegranate smoothie is made with only 5 ingredients that are easy to find throughout the winter!

items.raw: ½ cup pomegranate arils (plus more for serving)
items.name: pomegranate arils (plus more for serving)

steps.text: Place all the ingredients in a high-speed blender, blend for 60-120 seconds until you get a smooth and creamy texture.

steps.text: Taste the smoothie, adding milk if it's too thick or a sweetener if it’s not sweet enough for you. Pour into a cup or mason jar. Enjoy immediately, or store in fridge for up to 24 hours.
